# Zykken

> Zykken is an AI and business-systems studio in India. We build custom websites, WhatsApp and voice agents (Hindi and English), CRM, business software and automations. All work is custom-quoted, and every project starts with a free 30-minute audit. Contact: info@zykken.com

## Services
- [IntentPath — Websites & Guided Enquiries](https://www.zykken.com/services/intentpath): A carefully designed website that helps visitors choose a route, build an editable brief and reach the right person.
- [Carryline — WhatsApp & Voice Agents](https://www.zykken.com/services/carryline): WhatsApp, voice and chat agents in Hindi and English, connected by a shared handoff brief: what was asked, what was agreed and who takes over.
- [PledgeDesk — CRM & Follow-Through](https://www.zykken.com/services/pledgedesk): A CRM that tracks the commitments inside conversations, with source evidence, confirmed deadlines and follow-up ownership.
- [Flowback — Business Automations](https://www.zykken.com/services/flowback): Connected workflows with a recovery desk: see what completed, isolate what failed and approve a safe next step.
- [PreviewOps — Custom Software & Portals](https://www.zykken.com/services/previewops): Portals and internal tools with an approval preview: inspect affected records, review the change, then commit with a receipt.

## Results
- Luxe Estates (real estate): lead follow-up time went from 6 hours to 38 seconds. See https://www.zykken.com/work
